title: Creamy Norwegian Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole that combines the rich flavors of Norway with a creamy, cheesy twist.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with butter.
Open the can of casserole and drain the liquid.
In a separate bowl, mix the sour cream and shredded mozzarella.
Add the cooked krumkaker crumbs to the cream cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the casserole mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Top with the cream cheese mixture and spread it evenly.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
